in_arabic.name: Farbud
in_arabic.long_meaning: Farbud هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'furud', which means 'to bring forth, to make clear'. This name signifies a person who is a beacon of light and clarity, making their wisdom and knowledge accessible to others. In Islamic history, Farbud is a name given to scholars and wise leaders who guide their communities towards the righteous path.
